+Import `greet` from `./src/greet.ts` and call it with a name:
+
+```ts
+import { greet } from "./src/greet";
+
+greet(name: string): string
+```
+

+
+```ts
+greet("Ada"); // "Hello, Ada!"
+```
+
+- Empty name — returns the default greeting:
+
+```ts
+greet(""); // "Hello, world!"
+```
